from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyFinancialData(BaseModel):
    """Extracted financial data from a single company's report for ranking."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The full name of the company as reported")
    stock_code: str | None = Field(description="The stock/trading code of the company, if available")
    operating_revenue: float | None = Field(description="Operating Revenue amount for the reporting period")
    cash_received_from_sales: float | None = Field(description="Cash Received from Sale of Goods and Services amount for the reporting period")
    reporting_period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period string (e.g., '2025-03' or 'Q1 2025')")
    currency: str = Field(default="CNY", description="The currency of the financial figures")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    companies: list[CompanyFinancialData]
